decisions.summary: Single-intent branch reviewed as one unit; owner sato_keigo, no split required
decisions.reason: scope_reviewed: the branch was cut fresh from origin/main and carries only this Story (the two sibling Stories registered in the same upstream commit were deliberately excluded). review_owner_map: src/docs-only-change.js + src/evidence-cost-budget.js + src/evidence-depth-planner.js are the evidence-weight surface, src/merge-manager.js is the measurement surface, src/usage-report.js is the read-side projection; all five are owned by the same VibePro evidence-cost responsibility and reviewed together by the gate_evidence role. Splitting would require shipping a docs-only profile that consumes unmeasured change sets, which is the defect being removed.

decisions.summary: Bundled scope justified: one intent — evidence weight follows the measured change surface
decisions.reason: The four changed source modules form a single causal chain that cannot be split without shipping a broken intermediate state. src/docs-only-change.js produces the verdict; src/evidence-depth-planner.js and src/evidence-cost-budget.js are its only two consumers; src/merge-manager.js supplies the measurement the verdict depends on. Splitting the diff-base fix from the docs-only profile would land a profile that classifies unmeasured change sets, which is the exact misrecording DOE-S-3 removes. src/usage-report.js is a 19-line read-side projection of the field the budget split adds. Total 10 files / +1045 -57, of which 471 lines are new tests and 49 are the Story; one reviewer can hold the whole chain.
